template.name: Sangfor NGAF by SNMP
template.description: Sangfor NGAF monitoring via private SANGFOR-MIB (enterprises 35047), converted from the vendor MIB file SANGFOR-MIB.txt. Requires SNMP v2c or later (Counter64 objects). Interface rate/discard objects are converted with Change per second; if the device actually reports instantaneous rates, remove that preprocessing step. Memory counters arrive in kB and disk counters in MB.

item.name: Memory usage
item.params: (last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.mem.total)-last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.mem.free))/last(/Sangfor NGAF by SNMP/sangfor.mem.total)*100
